entries.title: SEC sets November 11, 2026 as its action date on Nasdaq ISE's proposed listing criteria for options on commodity-based trusts holding digital commodities
entries.facts: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission published in the Federal Register on September 24, 2026, as document 2026-19514, a notice captioned "Self-Regulatory Organizations; Nasdaq ISE, LLC; Notice of Designation of a Longer Period for Commission Action on a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Criteria for Underlying Securities" (Release No. 34-106448; File No. SR-ISE-2026-42). The document describes the underlying filing as "a proposed rule change to adopt listing criteria for options on commodity-based trusts that hold one or more digital commodities." It states that "the Commission, pursuant to Section 19(b)(2) of the Act, designates November 11, 2026, as the date by which the Commission shall either approve or disapprove, or institute proceedings to determine whether to disapprove, the proposed rule change." The notice cites the original filing as "Securities Exchange Act Release No. 106067 (Aug. 10, 2026), 91 FR 52387."

entries.relevant_to: options exchanges, digital-asset ETP sponsors and issuers, broker-dealers, crypto-derivatives platforms, market makers

entries.title: Coinbase Derivatives' customer-margin filing for security futures products publishes in the Federal Register; comments due on or before October 15, 2026
entries.facts: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission notice "Self-Regulatory Organizations; Coinbase Derivatives, LLC; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change Relating to Customer Margin Requirements for Security Futures Products" (Release No. 34-106443; File No. SR-COIN-2026-001) was published in the Federal Register on September 24, 2026 as document 2026-19512, at 91 FR 60670-60673. The document had been placed on Federal Register public inspection on September 23, 2026. The published text states that "CDE is submitting this proposed rule change to establish customer-level margin requirements for security futures that align with current Commission (and CFTC) requirements, as described in the following section," and that "All submissions should refer to file number SR-COIN-2026-001 and should be submitted on or before October 15, 2026."
entries.source_label: Federal Register — U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Notice, 09/24/2026 (Doc. 2026-19512, 91 FR 60670; Release No. 34-106443; File No. SR-COIN-2026-001)
